about.lead: Cybersecurity consulting for the cloud era.
about.intro: At DuRuVaSa, we specialize in providing top-notch cybersecurity consulting services designed to protect your organization from emerging threats. Our dedicated team of experts is committed to securing your digital landscape, ensuring compliance, and empowering your business with robust security measures.
paragraphs: DuRuVaSa CloudSec was built on a simple idea: security should be an enabler, not an obstacle. We help organisations see what is happening across their cloud, understand which risks matter most, and respond in minutes instead of hours.

The firm is led by founder Rajeshkumar Chemalli, who brings more than 22 years of experience in information security and technology, together with consulting partners Sidhartha Chaudhry Rayala and Deekshith G N, who focus on information security and SOC operations.

pillars.title: Our mission
pillars.text: To protect organisations from emerging threats by pairing AI-driven detection with expert human judgement, so every business can operate in the cloud with confidence.

pillars.title: Our approach
pillars.text: We start from your size, industry and risk level, then design the controls, monitoring and compliance that fit. No one-size-fits-all packages, and no paying for what you do not need.

pillars.title: Our commitment
pillars.text: Round-the-clock monitoring, rapid response and audit-ready evidence, delivered with personalised service and plain-language communication.

values.title: Proactive
values.text: We find and stop threats before they cause damage.

values.title: Transparent
values.text: Clear controls, clear evidence and clear reporting.

values.title: Tailored
values.text: Security shaped around your business, not a template.

values.title: Scalable
values.text: Protection that grows with your apps, users and regions.

partners.heading: OUR PARTNERS
partners.sub: We work alongside leading names in identity, AI security, analytics and security operations.

offerings.heading: Our Offerings
offerings.intro: We provide a comprehensive range of cybersecurity services, including breach prevention, compliance assurance, and 24/7 monitoring. Our solutions are designed to safeguard digital assets and ensure a proactive approach to cybersecurity.

attributes.heading: Innovative Elements for Cyber Defense
attributes.text: DuRuVaSa CloudSec is at the forefront of cybersecurity, dedicated to providing innovative solutions to protect digital assets and ensure compliance. Our team leverages AI for breach prevention and threat detection, offering tailored solutions for 24/7 monitoring.
